summary: Verified all 39 estimates against the supplied PDF after reading the complete 92,689-character markdown, including Appendices A and B. Checked every numerical source page and the methods supporting outcome codes, arm assignments, counts, timing, and uncertainty. Recorded statistics match the printed values for their outcomes and contrasts. Regression observation counts are correctly distinguished from people and randomized teams; unreported analyzed headcounts remain null. The conflicting Bayesian results in the main text and Appendix B are faithfully transcribed and explicitly identified as dependent reports. The expanded regressions retain the contrast between the original randomized team arms. No additional in-scope outcome or contrast was found in the supplied document; nonrandom individual-versus-team comparisons, post-treatment-adjusted analyses, moderation, mechanisms, completion time, and self-reports are appropriately excluded. External supplementary materials were not verified in this review.
